system.description:
Wouldst thou like to live deliciously? —Robert Eggers, The VVitch Witches are mediaries of magical secrets. One may become a witch through the whispers of a familiar or the favor of a being from beyond.

The witch is a debuffer focused on Casting Spells to stack detriments. Stick to the shadows and pile on Statuses through Hex.

  • Action: Cast
  • Move: Backline
  • Key Stat: Awareness
  • Complexity: HHHII
  • Training: Craft, Mysticism

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Occultist
features.description:
You gain a Perk with the Trained: Mysticism Prerequisite, and you can Cast Spells using Mysticism.

Spells: You learn 4 Spells. You learn 1 other Spell every 2 Levels hereafter.

Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (4 × your Level), and your Cast Max for Spells is equal to (2 + your Level).

features.name: Hex
features.description: When you affect Enemies with the effect of a Spell, you can hex one of the Targeted Enemies. Doing so causes the effect to be continual (p. 91) until you hex a new Target.

features.name: Widdershins
features.description:
Your damage from Spell effects and your effective Level for the purpose of Spell effects are both increased by 1 against your hexed Target, and increased 1 more every 4 Levels hereafter.

Witch: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Grudge Bearer
features.description:
The number of Spells you can cause to be continual on the Target with your Hex Feature increases by 1 now and every 4 Levels hereafter. Further, if you hex a new Target while you have an Enemy hexed, the new Target is affected by the previous Spells.

Witch: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Soul Link
features.description: Once per Action when you deal damage to an Enemy within Far of your hexed Target, the hexed Target also takes the damage.

features.name: Misery Business
features.description: If you deal damage to your hexed Target, they are considered Weak to the damage.
